caption: The wallet spends the 0.4 BTC and 0.3 BTC outputs together: 0.6 BTC goes to the merchant, 0.0005 BTC is the miner's fee, and 0.0995 BTC comes back as change to a fresh change-chain address. The change is your own money returning, not part of the fee: 0.4 + 0.3 = 0.6 + 0.0005 + 0.0995.

spec.title: Paying 0.6 BTC from three UTXOs
spec.aria: Two UTXOs of 0.4 BTC and 0.3 BTC are spent in one transaction that pays 0.6 BTC to the merchant, gives 0.0005 BTC as fee, and returns 0.0995 BTC change to a fresh change address.
